etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Latin ēlūdō (“to evade, elude”), from ē- (“out of”, short form of ex-) + lūdō (“to play; to trick”).
senses: (transitive) To evade or escape from (someone or something), especially by using cunning or skill.
(transitive) To shake off (a pursuer); to give someone the slip.
